rows.label: qst701509_msg0003
rows.name:
It's been a long time. We've both
gotten older, haven't we?

rows.label: qst701509_msg0004
rows.name:
Well, well... I'm at a loss.
What a day this has been.

rows.label: qst701509_msg0005
rows.name:
Have you created your
"greatest work"? I have
been waiting for it, Mirei.

rows.label: qst701509_msg0007
rows.name:
You stopped waiting long ago, didn't
you? Heh heh. You're as bad at lying
as ever.

rows.label: qst701509_msg0008
rows.name:
Ho ho ho... You still force a laugh
whenever you're trying to hide
something.

rows.label: qst701509_msg0009
rows.name: In any case, let's talk inside.
